description: This file contains implementation code for board-specific configuration overrides for the Prometheus engine control system, including setting default engine parameters, pin configurations, serial and SPI settings, and other hardware-specific overrides.

methods.name: setPrometheusDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default engine configuration parameters specific to the Prometheus board, including engine mode, trigger type, cylinders, firing order, ignition, injection modes, trigger offset, displacement, injector flow, cranking parameters, RPM limit, sensor types, and buffer length.

methods.name: setPinConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins for injection and ignition based on the hardware variant (determined by is469). Sets pin modes and initial states.

methods.name: setSerialConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Sets serial port usage and assigns serial TX/RX pins and speeds.

methods.name: setSdCardConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Enables SPI for SD card and sets the CS pin.

methods.name: setBoardConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Performs comprehensive hardware-specific configuration, including delay for SWD trigger, setting ADC channels, GPIO pins for various functions, SPI configurations, CAN bus, and other peripherals, with conditional adjustments based on the is469 hardware variant.
